info.name: Guess Market Server
info.description:
End-to-end tests of the Guess Market server: every endpoint, its errors, and the money behind every trade.

Before every run:
1. Restart Tomcat - the server keeps its data only in memory, so a restart gives a clean state.
2. Postman: Settings > General > Working Directory = the project's test-files folder (the upload tests read its XML files).

Two users are logged in at the same time: {{baseUrl}} (localhost) and {{baseUrl2}} (127.0.0.1) are the same server, but Postman keeps a separate cookie - so a separate session - for each host name.
The collection-level test script runs after every request and checks that every answer is JSON.

exec: // Runs after EVERY request: the server always answers JSON, and every error has the same shape.
pm.test("[every request] the answer is JSON", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/json"));
pm.test("[every request] an error looks like {\"error\": \"...\"}", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.be.a("string").that.is.not.empty);
